items.content_html: Mint Parchment is an AI-powered study assistant prototype designed to help students quickly refresh academic concepts using concise, auto-generated jot notes. The website integrates Chrome’s built-in Prompt API to locally generate summaries without requiring server-side models, making the tool lightweight, privacy-preserving, and fast.
